{{Quote|You'll only have about ten minutes once you're down there before the security droids get too suspicious. And be sure not to harm any of the security droids or they will raise the alarm.|[[Cyru Sarkee]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DNSD" />}}
The '''S-1 security droid''' was a variant of the [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] used as a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], S-1 and [[S-2 security droid]]s were used by the [[Corellian Security Force]] to patrol the underground [[Coronet Maintenance Tunnels|maintenance tunnels]] located beneath the surface of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], especially the [[Coronet Maintenance Tunnels#Lower Maintenance Areas|lower maintenance areas]]. The anti-technology fanatics of the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump gang]] sometimes encountered and fought S-1 and S-2 security droids since they had established their [[Meatlump Hideout|secret hideout]] in abandoned maintenance tunnels located just above the lower maintenance areas.<ref name="SWG:DNSD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The S-1 security droid appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DNSD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The S-1 security droid was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]", introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
